title: Size Bound for Encoded Seam Words
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word and let $s$ be a streaming seam state whose consumed length is at most $|x|$ and whose fresh-variable cursor is at most $|x|$ plus its consumed length. Then the fresh-variable cursor is at most $2|x|$, and the encoded seam word has length at most $6|x|+8$.
hypotheses_covered: Streaming seam state $s$ satisfies the consumed-length and fresh-cursor bounds
replaced:
If a seam state satisfies the length invariant on an input $x$, then its fresh
cursor is at most $2\,|x|$ and its encoded seam word has length at most
$6\,|x| + 8$.
